services: docker compose up -d mysql mongo redis

notes.ports.DB_PORT: docker-compose.yml publishes mysql's port from $DB_PORT, so nothing in it is rewritten
notes.services: docker-compose.yml: services with an image and no build

compose.cannotRunTwice: compose's compose file names its containers (container_name: umbrella_mysql in mysql), so it cannot run in two workspaces at once. Run it from one place with Bring to Main, or remove container_name from docker-compose.yml.
